verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs repeatedly describe Airbyte Core as "Airbyte's open source product", and its source is published on GitHub under the airbytehq org (the main repo and the platform repo hosting the API spec). abctl is also described as open source. A community comment says some parts are non-free, which limits the extent of openness but does not contradict that the core source is readable under an open license. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named in the evidence, the boundary between open and non-free (enterprise/security) components is undocumented, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
